sloka: येनाद्य निहता युद्धे राक्षसा विनिपातिताः ।तस्यमेव क्षितौ वीरः स शेते निहतः परैः ।। ६.४९.१५ ।।।।
transliteration: yenādya nihatā yuddhe rākṣasā vinipātitāḥ ।tasyameva kṣitau vīraḥ sa śete nihataḥ paraiḥ ।। 6.49.15 ।।।।

translations.english: "Lying on the bed of arrows in the network of arrows, blood flowing out from the body he remains shining like the setting sun."
